scripts.setup:quant: python3 -m venv services/quant-engine/.venv && services/quant-engine/.venv/bin/pip install services/quant-engine
scripts.test: npm run test:quant && npm run test:python && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
scripts.test:quant: node --import tsx --test tests/chart-model.test.ts tests/chart-consumers.test.tsx tests/quant.test.ts tests/portfolio.test.ts tests/market-making.test.ts tests/strategies.test.ts tests/analytics-guidance.test.ts tests/analytics-components.test.tsx tests/content.test.ts tests/academy-content.test.ts tests/academy-components.test.tsx tests/platform-map.test.ts tests/search.test.ts tests/intelligence.test.ts tests/ai.test.ts tests/market-data.test.ts tests/quant-bateman.test.ts tests/server-http.test.ts tests/licensing.test.ts
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run cloudflare:preflight && npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply thequantbateman-production --local
scripts.db:migrate:production: npm run cloudflare:preflight && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply thequantbateman-production --remote
